text:
maya: Heads up — seeing sustained tail latency and a spike in 5xxs from NA-west GPU pool (pool-3). Queue length at the frontends jumped ~3x in the last 4m. https://dash.redwood.internal/g/na-west/pool-3 (graphs)

nora (oncall): ack. Is this isolated to pool-3 or cross-region?

maya: looks localized to pool-3 hosts behind the same egress tier. NIC tx drops + retransmits rising after the kernel rollback we rolled yesterday. No full host loss, just degraded throughput causing token stream stalls.

liam: ok. Proposal: steer ~25% of production GLB traffic off na-west → split to eu-west (60%) and apac (40%) as short-term mitigation. Lower route TTL to 15s so clients rebalance faster. Tradeoff: higher cache misses and slightly higher token cost. Thoughts?

sophia: cost note — eu-west reserved pools have spare headroom but we might need to spin some burst hosts. Estimate +8-12% on token egress costs during the window. Also we should avoid forcing long-running KV cache invalidation; TTL=15s ok for safety?

maya: agree. I'll apply a temporary steer override. Steps I'll run:

```
# create short-lived steer override
gslbctl policy create --name "egress-steer-override-1802345678" \ 
  --match "route:prod" \ 
  --weights "na-west:75,eu-west:15,apac:10" \ 
  --ttl 15s --expiry 15m

# verify
gslbctl policy get --name "egress-steer-override-1802345678" --watch 60
```

ops-runner: executing command on behalf of maya: `gslbctl policy create ...` — started at 1802345732

infra-bot: Policy applied as "egress-steer-override-1802345678". Monitoring metrics for 5xx rate and queue depth for 5m. Alerts will fire if 5xx > 1% for 3m.

maya: after ~60s: 5xx rate dropped from 3.1% → 0.9%, queue length trending down. Token latency p50 ~ stable, p95 improved from 2.2s → 1.1s.

liam: good signal. Keep the override for 15m, then we can either extend or roll back depending on kernel fix progress. Also file a follow-up to ensure NIC firmware/driver change is staged properly before we demote traffic.

nora (oncall): opened incident INC-2026-4539 and added the above policy id + timing. Please add a short cost estimate to the ticket for finance.

sophia: added estimate to INC-2026-4539 — projected incremental spend ~+$1.2k for the 15m window if we sustain the shifts and burst hosts come online.

maya: noted. I'll continue to coordinate with kernel/host owners. If anyone sees new 5xx spikes after we revert, ping here and I'll reapply.

liam: when we revert, do a canary roll back first (5% → 25% → full) to avoid flash re-introducing queues.

maya: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Note: policy "egress-steer-override-1802345678" will auto-expire at 1802346578 unless extended.
